issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

baseURL.description: Base url for the application. Used for embedding links into email notifications.

companyName.description: The business entity that the application is being deployed for. Displayed at the top of {@link WorkOrder} reports.

dataValidationHardwareProfile.description: The id of the {@link HardwareProfile} that will be used to all DataValidationBatchJob instances.

dataValidationJobPriority.description: The priority to be assigned to all DataValidationBatchJob instances.

myCasesFilter.description: Specifies the filter used to fetch the user's cases. Use {{userId}} as a placeholder for the current user's id.

activitiesFetchLimit.description: The limit for the fetch call used to retrieve activities related to actions performed on ReliabilityAssetAlert and ReliabilityAssetCase instances. The default value is set to 2000.

modelName.description: The name of the LLM Model used for Expected Sensor Matching.
